components.name: Frame
components.childDescription: The frame is like the bike’s skeleton. It holds everything together so you can ride safely.
components.expertDescription: A lightweight, rigid frame improves handling and reduces energy loss, allowing better power transfer.
components.brandNote: Sport‑brand bikes use aluminium or carbon frames to keep weight low and boost acceleration.

components.name: Engine
components.childDescription: The engine is the heart that makes the bike go vroom! It creates the power that moves the bike.
components.expertDescription: Higher displacement and tuned combustion increase torque, giving quicker bursts of speed.
components.brandNote: Racing brands often use high‑revving four‑cylinder engines for top‑end power.

components.name: Tires
components.childDescription: Tires are the shoes of the bike. They grip the road so you don’t slip.
components.expertDescription: Wider, softer compounds provide better traction, while a slick profile reduces rolling resistance.
components.brandNote: Performance brands fit sport‑tread tires to maximise grip in corners.

components.name: Brakes
components.childDescription: Brakes are the bike’s hands that help it stop safely.
components.expertDescription: Larger, ventilated discs paired with multi‑pad calipers shorten stopping distance.
components.brandNote: High‑end models use ABS and dual‑channel brakes for tighter control.

components.name: Suspension
components.childDescription: The suspension is the bike’s cushion, smoothing out bumps so the ride feels comfy.
components.expertDescription: Adjustable preload and damping let riders tune handling for different tracks.
components.brandNote: Racing bikes feature upside‑down forks and rear linkages for precise feedback.

components.name: Exhaust
components.childDescription: The exhaust is the pipe that lets the engine breathe out its noisy sighs.
components.expertDescription: Free‑flow designs reduce back‑pressure, allowing the engine to expel gases faster and gain power.
components.brandNote: Sport bikes often use titanium exhausts to cut weight and improve performance.
